description: This file defines a scraper class 'SchoolOfWok' for extracting recipe data from the 'schoolofwok.co.uk' website, including methods for retrieving title, cuisine, total time, yields, image, ingredients, ingredient groups, instructions, and description.

classes.name: SchoolOfWok
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe details from the School of Wok website.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the host URL for the website.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Returns the author name of the recipe.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Extracts the recipe title from the page.

methods.name: cuisine
methods.description: Extracts the cuisine type from the page.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Returns grouped ingredients based on headers.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Returns cooking instructions as a string.
